●二次電池(充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しないでください。
●古い電池と新しい電池、いろいろな種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。
●+(プラスマイナス)を正しくセットしてください。

●万一、 電池から漏れた液が目に入ったときはすぐに大量の水で洗い、医師に相談してください。

blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries. Keep it away from young children who might swallow them. There is a choking hazard.
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may break it.
• Do not put a bag over your head or cover your face with it. There is a risk of suffocation.
• Do not play roughly, such as by hitting or swinging the product.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. They may become trapped and cause injury.
• This product contains a speaker. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. Doing so may make you feel sick.
• Incorrect battery use can cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert the batteries with the correct + and - polarity.
• Always turn the switch off and remove the batteries after use. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow local municipal disposal regulations.
• Do not use the product close to your ear. Accidental use near the ear may damage hearing.
